SkyForge
VST3 instrument for Windows · by SoSkyride
$26 $29 on itch.io
🔥 Sale on itch.io through 11/4: 54% off the full itch.io price

An analog-style instrument for Ableton Live. Put it on a MIDI track, arm, and play. If all you've got is the computer keyboard, that still writes the clip.

The Kind row (Earth, Water, Fire, Wind) changes the voice, not the skin. Halloween, Waters, and Aether sit on top. Ear Wyrm records what you played and cuts a clip from it, dragon and all. Bounce a WAV if you want the audio.

  • Windows VST3 (64-bit)
  • Analog-style synth, not a sample pack
  • 2 oscillators, filter, ADSR, unison
  • Kind: Earth / Water / Fire / Wind
  • Computer-keyboard MIDI into Live
  • Ear Wyrm clips, bounce, MIDI dump
  • Forge + Rack skins, user presets
Buy $26 Free demo

Instant download link by email after checkout. The free demo is the browser version: unzip and open index.html. Install: unzip into C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\, then in Live turn on VST3 system folders and Rescan. Sales are final; if it won't load in a VST3 host on Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), write in and we fix the build.
